jobs.description:
We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years. With huge change comes huge opportunity. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the freedom to develop better solutions and move your career forward in new directions. We are looking for an engaged and proactive Asset Engineer Electrical to take ownership of the electrical assets supporting our manufacturing operations.
 
Impact you’ll own
Be responsible for ensuring safe, reliable and efficient operation of production equipment through effective asset lifecycle management, maintenance strategy development and continuous improvement initiatives
Ensure compliance with all applicable electrical safety regulations, standards and company requirements
Work closely with Production, Maintenance, Automation and Project teams to improve equipment performance and availability
Ensure technical documentation is accurate, updated and accessible and support standardization of electrical equipment and spare parts
Support annual maintenance and investment budget planning and find opportunities to reduce maintenance costs and improve energy efficiency

 
What you’ll do
Lead and support electrical risk assessments and mitigation activities
Promote a strong safety culture through proactive identification and elimination of risks
Maintain and continuously improve the asset register for electrical equipment
Develop and optimize preventive and predictive maintenance strategies and provide technical expertise in solving issues and root cause analysis
Identify and implement solutions to reduce equipment downtime and improve reliability
Support capital projects, equipment upgrades and new technology implementation
Drive continuous improvement activities focused on equipment reliability and performance
Participate actively in TPM, Lean Manufacturing and IOS/OPEN+ initiatives
Develop technical capability within maintenance and operations teams through coaching and collective learning

 
Skills & capabilities
Must have
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
Minimum 2 years of experience within a manufacturing environment
Working experience with industrial electrical systems, motor control, power distribution and machine safety
Experience with SAP PM, CMMS or similar maintenance management systems
Fluency in English both written and spoken

Nice to have
Experience with PLCs, automation systems and industrial controls is considered an advantage
Fluency in Swedish both written and spoken

 
Rewards & benefits
Collective Bargaining Agreement
Occupational pension and comprehensive insurance coverage
SEK 5,000 annual wellness allowance
Generous parental benefits, including reduced working hours with full pay during the first month back after parental leave
Jubilee Awards recognizing long-term service and dedication

 
Equal Opportunities Statement
We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and provide reasonable accommodations to ensure an accessible recruitment process.

2MNordic is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer for a long-term client assignment in Malmö. You will build complex web interfaces where performance, reliability, accessibility and privacy are central to the user experience.
You will join a small, autonomous team and take ownership from early design discussions through
development, testing and production. The role suits someone who can turn broad requirements into practical solutions, challenge assumptions and adapt as priorities evolve.
Your responsibilities
• Develop and maintain web applications using React, TypeScript and modern CSS.
• Work closely with designers, product managers and backend engineers to deliver usable, reliable interfaces.
• Build complex single-page applications with effective state management and data-heavy views.
• Improve performance through code splitting, lazy loading and rendering optimisation.
• Integrate REST APIs, handling latency, failures and incomplete data throughout the user experience.
• Make accessibility and automated testing part of everyday delivery.
• Break larger features into manageable increments and contribute to technical decisions, code reviews and documentation.
Practical details
This assignment requires onsite presence in Malmö. You should already be based within commuting distance or be willing to relocate. The assignment is long term, allowing you to build domain knowledge and contribute throughout the product lifecycle.
Your experience
• Typically five or more years of frontend development experience, with applications delivered and
maintained in production.
• Strong JavaScript knowledge, including asynchronous behaviour, the event loop, browser rendering
and memory management.
• Deep practical experience with React, TypeScript and modern CSS.
• Proven ability to diagnose issues across devices, slow networks and large datasets.
• A strong understanding of user experience and interaction design, including how interfaces behave
with real data.
• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, Docker and GitHub workflows.
• The ability to investigate dependencies beyond their documentation when needed.
• Clear written and verbal communication in English, including explaining technical decisions to different audiences.
• Confidence working independently while coordinating dependencies across teams.
Additional merits
• Familiarity with WebAssembly, WebGPU, canvas rendering or browser security.
• Backend development knowledge, particularly Java.
About 2MNordic
2MNordic is a Swedish IT consultancy founded in 2001. We help companies turn technological
complexity into operational capability through software development, solution architecture, automation, AI and data.
As a consultant with 2MNordic, you contribute your expertise to client assignments while being part of an experienced consultancy with close collaboration and a practical approach to delivery.
Learn more at 2mnordic.com.
Interested in this assignment?
Send us your CV or consultant profile, availability and a short overview of your React and TypeScript experience. Please include your current location and ability to work onsite in Malmö

Company description:
At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.
Job description: 
 Plan and deliver complex international project schedules
 Are you an experienced project planner who enjoys working with large-scale projects from tender phase through execution to completion? As a Senior Project Planner at NKT, you will play a key role in planning, monitoring, and reporting across complex projects that support the green transition. Working closely with international teams, clients, and project stakeholders, you will help ensure transparent and reliable project execution. Would you like to contribute to some of the infrastructure projects shaping a more sustainable future?
  
 Coordinate planning across major project phases
 As Senior Project Planner, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimising integrated project schedules covering the full project lifecycle. You will work closely with project teams, clients, subcontractors, and management to provide clear visibility of project progress and support informed decision-making through accurate planning and reporting.
  
 Your responsibility will be to:
  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules in Primavera P6 from tender to project completion
 • Monitor project progress, identify schedule risks and support mitigation activities
 • Coordinate planning activities across subcontractors, suppliers, manufacturing, installation and commissioning
 • Prepare planning reports, dashboards, S-curves, milestone analyses and executive summaries
 • Support contract and project management teams with delay assessments, claims support and schedule analysis
  
 
 The position is based in Rotterdam, Netherlands. You will collaborate with international teams and be expected to travel for client meetings, site visits, and department activities held in Karlskrona.
  
 Structured planner with collaborative stakeholder approach
 You are a structured and proactive person who enjoys balancing detailed analysis with collaboration across different functions and cultures. You communicate clearly, build positive working relationships, and are comfortable discussing different perspectives to support well-founded project decisions. You take ownership of your work, maintain a methodical approach, and keep focus on quality and accuracy.
  
 You also have:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline
 • Extensive experience in project planning within large project environments
 • Advanced knowledge of Primavera P6
 • Experience with project reporting and data visualisation tools such as Power BI
 • Professional fluency in English, written and spoken
 • Experience from renewable energy, offshore wind, submarine cable, oil & gas, EPC or large infrastructure projects is considered advantageous

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager for an automotive company in Gothenburg. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

We are looking for a technical project manager who dares to challenge, gets people working together and takes responsibility for the outcome.

Executive summary
We are looking for someone who dares to challenge, gets people working together and takes responsibility for the outcome.

You bring

Solid experience managing complex technical projects and driving technical investigations, preferably within cloud platforms or software engineering.

Good technical understanding of cloud environments, DevOps and ideally observability technologies such as Grafana, Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

Experience coordinating multiple teams with different priorities and dependencies.

Strong communication skills, the ability to challenge assumptions and build alignment, and a structured but pragmatic mindset.

Want to help us take observability at WirelessCar to the next level?
We're looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to drive our observability initiatives, focusing on modern cloud-native observability solutions for monitoring, logging, metrics, distributed tracing and alerting, potentially leveraging technologies such as Grafana and OpenTelemetry on Kubernetes.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with modern technology, talented engineering teams and complex cloud environments, making a real difference in how we monitor and operate our connected services.

What You'll Do

Drive and coordinate technical projects across multiple teams and stakeholders.

Lead planning, follow-up and coordination of platform migrations and adoption.

Work closely with architects, platform engineers, DevOps and SRE teams.

Manage dependencies, risks and priorities, making sure blockers get resolved.

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.

Ensure new solutions are not just delivered, but successfully adopted and ready for operations.

Keep stakeholders informed and help drive decisions when needed.

Who We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-moving technical environment and knows how to get things done.

You bring:

Solid experience managing complex technical projects, preferably within cloud platforms or software engineering.

Good technical understanding of cloud environments, DevOps and, ideally, observability technologies such as Grafana, Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

Experience coordinating multiple teams with different priorities and dependencies.

Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge stakeholders when needed.

A structured but pragmatic mindset, with a focus on results rather than processes for the sake of processes.

You don't need to be the technical expert in the room, but you should understand enough to ask the right questions and challenge the answers.

 This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

 Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

Technical Lead – Active Chassis Systems
At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and delivering the products of tomorrow for the world's leading manufacturers.
We are currently looking for a Embedded Software Engineer to join a highly innovative team developing next-generation Active Chassis and Suspension Systems for future vehicle platforms. This role offers the opportunity to work across the full software stack, developing advanced control functions that enhance vehicle dynamics, comfort, and driving performance.
About the Assignment
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for developing software for advanced suspension systems. The team works across application software, middleware, control algorithms, and supporting toolchains to deliver cutting-edge active chassis functionality. You will collaborate closely with software developers, system engineers, safety engineers, and test engineers, contributing throughout the software development lifecycle from concept to validation.
Main Responsibilities
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will:
Develop application software in C++ and middleware software in C for active chassis and suspension systems.

Contribute to software development for both dedicated ECUs and centralized vehicle computing platforms.

Collaborate with system, safety, and test engineers in a cross-functional environment.

Support integration, testing, validation, and troubleshooting activities.

Participate in the development of control algorithms and supporting toolchains.

Contribute to software quality, performance, and safety throughout the development process.

Drive technical improvements and continuous development of products and processes.

Required Qualifications
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field.

Minimum 5 years of experience in C++ (C++11/C++14) and/or C (C90/C99) development.

Minimum 5 years of experience in real-time embedded software development.

Experience within the automotive industry.

Experience working with AUTOSAR.

Knowledge of automotive communication protocols, including: CAN, Automotive Ethernet, Experience with UDS (Unified Diagnostic Services).

Experience using Vector tools such as: CANoe, CANalyzer, vTESTstudio

Knowledge of low-level embedded protocols: SPI, UART, PWM, DIO, PSI5

Experience with HIL systems and real-time simulation environments.

Knowledge of ISO 26262 Functional Safety implementation.

Familiarity with automotive cybersecurity standards.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on, then we would love to hear from you.
Tata Technologies: Engineering a better world.
Tata Technologies would like to thank all applicants for their interest; each application will be reviewed against the set criteria for the role. We would like to advise that only candidates under consideration will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 10 working days following the closing date, it will mean that unfortunately your application has not been successful. We will however retain your details for any suitable future opportunities.

Who we are 
We've completed over 40 million deliveries, serving millions of consumers and some of the largest e-commerce retailers in the Nordics. As a leading home delivery provider in Sweden, we've grown by 50%+ annually and are approaching SEK 1 billion in revenue.
And we're just getting started. With a proven platform, growing market share and significant opportunities ahead, we're entering our next phase of growth.
We're large enough to operate at real scale, yet small enough for one leader to fundamentally change how the company works. We believe technology should remove complexity, not create it.
 About the role
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in logistics and operations while taking on increasing responsibility in a fast-growing company.
As a Partner Coordinator at Airmee, you’ll play a role in ensuring our delivery network runs smoothly and efficiently. You will be the go-to contact for selected last mile and linehaul carriers, making sure they receive the support, information, and coordination needed to deliver great service. You’ll be a part of our Carrier Management team and work closely with other Partner coordinators and the Partnership Manager to support both daily operations and planning activities.
Key responsibilities:

Act as the point of contact for a selection of our last mile and linehaul carriers, ensuring they receive timely support and information

Monitor daily performance and service quality using dashboards and KPIs, and share insights with both carriers and internal teams

Collaborate with Dispatch and other teams to quickly resolve issues related to delays, damages, or customer complaints

Assist in capacity planning by aligning vehicle supply with both short-term fluctuations and long-term forecasts

Ensure scheduling and shift templates are accurate and up to date, and help fill gaps through close coordination with carrier partners

Support the onboarding of new carriers and ensure compliance with Airmee’s standards, Code of Conduct, and operational routines

Who are we looking for?
We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, operational environment and enjoys working collaboratively to solve problems and keep things running smoothly.

You’re detail-oriented and structured, but flexible enough to adapt when plans change.

You have a natural sense of ownership and take initiative to improve day-to-day operations.

With communication skills, you build trust with both internal teams and external partners.

Being data-minded, you use insights to guide decisions and drive performance forward.

Requirements:
Experience in logistics, customer support, operations or similar.

Fluency in Swedish or English.

Good Excel skills

Are You Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?
Submit your application today!

Join Midsummer as a Production Operator at our production facility in Järfälla. You'll work with the manufacturing of our lightweight and flexible solar panels, supporting efficient production and consistent product quality.
This is a role for someone who enjoys practical work, takes pride in quality and is interested in technology and manufacturing. You'll work closely with your colleagues in production and contribute to stable processes and daily operations.
Please note that we are primarily recruiting for our evening shift.

What you'll be doing
As we rotate between different workstations and production steps, your tasks may vary over time. Depending on your workstation, the role may include:

Operating and monitoring automated and semi-automated production processes

Manufacturing and assembling solar cells and solar panels throughout different stages of production

Working with small components that require precision and attention to detail

Performing quality checks and documenting production results

Monitoring processes and reporting deviations

Following work instructions, procedures and safety routines

Collaborating with colleagues to ensure an efficient production flow

Supporting continuous improvements within the production team

The role requires you to work both independently and as part of a team while taking ownership of your responsibilities following your training period.

What we're looking for
An interest in technology and the ability to understand manufacturing processes

The ability to read, understand and follow technical instructions and work procedures

A structured and quality-focused way of working

Fluency in English, both written and spoken

The ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Previous experience from industrial production, assembly work, manufacturing environments or other roles involving precision and quality control is considered advantageous.
Technical, industrial or scientific education is also considered advantageous.

Who you are
You're reliable, responsible and quality conscious. You work in a structured manner, follow established procedures and take ownership of your work.
You have a safety-focused mindset and understand the importance of following routines and maintaining high quality standards. At the same time, you're a team player with good collaboration skills, adaptable to changing priorities and interested in technology and production.
Most importantly, you're motivated to learn, contribute and grow as part of the production team.

About Midsummer
Midsummer is a Swedish solar energy company that develops and manufactures lightweight, flexible solar cells with a carbon footprint approximately 90% lower than traditional solar panels. We control the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished products.
In addition to our own production, Midsummer develops and supplies complete manufacturing systems for flexible thin-film solar cells to customers around the world.
By joining Midsummer, you'll become part of a team contributing to the production of solar technology while working in an international and collaborative environment.

Interested?
We review applications continuously, so don't hesitate to submit your application.
We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Scrum Master/Agile Coach is needed for a consulting assignment within a large organisation undergoing a transformation to improve and coordinate its agile product development. The assignment focuses on supporting the consolidation of four previously separate products and backlogs into one unified product with a clearly prioritised common backlog.
You will coach and support 3–4 development teams throughout this transition, helping establish shared ways of working, stronger cross-team collaboration, and effective delivery processes. The role requires a confident agile leader who can drive change pragmatically, create engagement, and enable teams and stakeholders to work toward common product goals.
Key Responsibilities
Coach and facilitate 3–4 agile development teams in their day-to-day delivery and continuous improvement work.
Support the transition from separate products and backlogs to a unified product and prioritised common backlog.
Develop, implement, and continuously improve shared agile processes and ways of working across teams.
Facilitate Scrum ceremonies and ensure they provide clear value for teams and stakeholders.
Identify, visualise, and help manage dependencies between teams, product areas, and deliveries.
Strengthen collaboration and alignment among development teams working toward the same product objectives.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to monitor delivery flow and prioritisation.
Drive data-informed improvement initiatives focused on capacity, delivery predictability, and operational efficiency.
Use flow-based metrics, including Throughput, Work in Progress (WIP), Lead Time, and Cycle Time, to support improvement efforts.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Deep practical knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, and agile ways of working.
Hands-on experience using Jira for backlog management, sprint planning, and capacity planning.
Experience with agile transformation and organisational change management.
Knowledge of scaled agile frameworks such as SAFe, LeSS, or Nexus is advantageous.
Experience facilitating work across multiple teams delivering toward a shared product and common backlog.
Ability to use delivery-flow data and relevant metrics to identify bottlenecks and drive measurable improvements.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal consultant has at least 8 years of experience as a Scrum Master in large organisations. You have documented experience coaching and facilitating 3–4 agile teams in parallel, coordinating teams working toward a shared product or backlog, and leading agile transformation initiatives. Experience consolidating multiple backlogs into one common backlog is desirable. You are structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, with the ability to create engagement and effective collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
Professional fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken, is required.
